what: Eight pre-registered attempts to merge a merge request with an unnamed extra past the optional hold (eval/bypass_matrix_cases.json). Counts only.
limits: Eight scenarios we thought of, one run each, one project. It counts what we tried, not what is possible.
why_two_job_edits_were_blocked: Scenarios 'job deleted' and 'script emptied' did not merge because the project's own unit tests (tests/test_checker_job.py) read .gitlab-ci.yml and failed in the merge request pipeline, not because of the hold; a merge request could edit those tests too (not tried).
